searchText: i'm getting lots of 503s on the beaconchain explorer. am i the only one? Not just you, it's offline at the moment Restart your lighthouse beacon with `--eth1-purge-cache` Awesome, it worked! Thanks Anyone running besu? None of my instances are syncing now. <@!474451342094499868> I did a fresh sync with new data dir and it stops at 5500 (hash: 0x3367b402ece0f97395af9f78310c2b658c2acb2f2ad8ca2ff4fd378f8f09259d) Reports that chain download is complete but doesn't seem to import new blocks from there I don't know if I'm just missing a config flag. These are mine: https://pastebin.com/qqcztkn0 I'm running Besu/Teku, am in sync right now What was the issue? did you build besu yourself or are you running a docker? if so which hash is the build from. I cannot reproduce using the startup settings from your pastebin ah, you meant 55000, not 5500 as confitmed by your hash. Yes, besu stopped there since we hit TTD at 55182(?). It will not import more blocks from peers after that, it waits for the CL to direct it I'm on 45aa25ea6f1eb8a885f46870d55cd5585687635f. None of the CL clients trigger syncing past 55126. I love this error. 😂 ``` Cannot merge previous historical run because headers of 0x2b64ffbec3ef505b94 and 0xd80f3807ffa52b698f do not equal. Ignoring previous run. Did someone lie to us? ``` I tried clearing the besu database folder, and now I'm seeing lots of that along with BackwardSyncStep errors. ERRO Validator is missing fee recipient... why?? also my validator which was validating a few days ago is now pending. how can that be? The second one is interesting, what's the client? lighthouse
